blurb: Experience the magic of silent flight as you soar on Mother Nature's thermal engine in a state-of-the-art two-seat glider. Flights range from 30-minutes to 1.5-hours, with longer flights soaring high above the Beaufort Range or Mt. Arrowsmith offering panoramic views of Georgia Strait and the West Coast of Vancouver
